product_metadata.title: Sunolga 48" Weighted Door Draft Stopper Under Door Noise Air Stopper 3LB, Triangular Column Sound Proof Draft Guard for Doors and Windows, Machine Washable - Grey
features: ALL SEASON PROTECTION - 48 inches（measure after straightening） door draft stopper prevents cold air from getting in and warm air from escaping,you can place them on any windows, sliding or glass doors.

WEIGHTED & NON-SLIP DESIGN - Under door draft stopper heavy duty is filled with 3D high elastic cotton with glass beads to confirm its stability.Non-slip design on the bottom and heavy duty with 3Lbs that can snug tightly to the door.（PS：If you want it to be heavier, you can open the side zipper, add glass beads or stones by yourself）

TRIANGULAR DESIGN - With the triangular column design, it fits the door tightly. Of course, you can also use the hook&loop that comes with our product ,it can be move with the doors when you open or close.This door stopper not cause any damage to your doors ,fits all floor types.
MULTIFUNCTIONAL- Besides heat & cold insulation, our door draft stopper can help you with dampening outside noise,odors,light,and dust for a better sleep, as well as safeguard your family from pests.

EASY STORAGE - Simple color with elegant appearance; especially with two hanging loops, you are able to hang it on anywhere, such as door handle, closet hook, etc.Draft stoppers for bottom of doors can be quickly cleaned by washing machine, no more hand wash, save your time and labor.
